cards.audioText: AFR101, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，北京离场，已识别，上升标压6000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 6000m on standard, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升标压6000米，法航101。

cards.audioText: [Flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them. Require emergency descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机组人员报告称有一名男子身上携带爆炸物，并试图引爆它。请求紧急下降至3000米。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, AFR101, request descent to 3000m, a man is attempting to detonate explosives strapped to his body, the flight attendants are trying to get him under control.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京离场，法航101，请求下降至3000米，一名男子试图引爆绑在身上的爆炸物，机组人员正在试图控制他。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, descend to 3000m on QNH 1011. Say endurance. [Readback and report that you can hold for 2 hours more.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，下降到3000，修压1011，报告续航时间。【复诵并报告你可以坚持2个多小时。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000m on QNH 1011, endurance 2 hours, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到3000，修压1011，续航时间2小时，法航101。

cards.audioText: JAL220, maintain present heading and descend to 5100m, contact Approach 112.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，保持当前航向，下到5100米，联系进近112.5。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading and descend to 5100m, contact 112.5, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下到5100米，联系进近112.5，日航220。

cards.audioText: During the descend, a flock of birds struck your aircraft and your windshield was broken. The cabin crew reported that the oxygen masks in the cabin dropped automatically. You asked for radar vectors to Wuhan airport for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，一群鸟撞到你的飞机，你的风挡玻璃破裂了。乘务员报告称，客舱的氧气面罩自动脱落。你请求雷达引导至武汉机场，进行优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, JAL220, we encountered bird strike during the descent. The windshield was broken. Oxygen masks fell down in cabin, Request radar vectors and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉区调，日航220，我们在下降过程中遭遇鸟击。风挡玻璃破裂。氧气面罩脱落，请求雷达引导，优先着陆。

cards.audioText: JAL220, roger Mayday, descend to 5400m and contact Wuhan Approach on 115.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到Mayday，下降到5400米，联系武汉进近115.5。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5400m, contact Wuhan Approach on 115.5, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到5400米，联系武汉进近115.5，日航220。

cards.audioText: CES220, cleared to maintain 12500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，可以保持12500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to maintain 12500m. CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以保持12500米，东方220。

cards.audioText: [The plane encounters a strong head wind, and fuel is running out, the warning light is on, request alternate to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机遭遇强烈顶风，燃料正在耗尽，燃料示警灯亮了，请求备降北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CES220, request alternate to Beijing airport, we are running out of fuel due to head winds en route, our fuel light is on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，请求备降北京机场，由于巡航途中顶风燃料快耗尽，燃料警示灯亮着。

cards.audioText: CES220, roger, report endurance.[Report that your endurance is about 1 hour and 30 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，收到，报告续航时间。【报告你的续航时间约为1小时30分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Endurance 0130, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间0130，东方220。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306, runway 31 via taxiway D1 B1 and A12.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，经滑行道D1，B1和A12滑到跑道31。
cards.referenceText: Runway 31, taxiway D1 B1 and A12, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道31，滑行道D1，B1和A12，南航6306。

cards.audioText: [Now you are en route, the No.2 engine failed, call Shanghai Control to request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你在航路上，2号发动机故障，联系上海区调并请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Shanghai Control, CSN6306, engine failure on No.2, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, 上海区调，南航6306，2号发动机故障，请求下降。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306, descend to 5400m initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，初步下降到5400米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5400m initially, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 初步下降到5400米，南航6306。

cards.audioText: CCA991, negative due to Air Force restriction. Resume course as soon as able.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，由于空军限制区不可以，尽快归航。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, resuming course, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，归航，国航991。

cards.audioText: [You find smoke coming from engine bleed air system. Declare urgency to ATC, request lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现发动机引气系统有烟冒出，向ATC宣布紧急，请求更低高度。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CCA991, smoke is coming from engine bleed system, request lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，发动机引气系统有烟冒出，请求更低高度。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control, roger PANPAN, descend to and maintain 6900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持6900米。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, descend to and maintain 6900m, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，下降保持6900米，国航991。

cards.audioText: SIA635, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，上升保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 3000m, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持3000米，新航635。

cards.audioText: [The cabin crew reported that there’s smoke coming from the air condition system in the cabin, make an urgency call and advise approach you want to level off at present level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机组报告客舱内的空调系统冒烟了，做紧急呼叫，告诉进近你想在当前高度平飞。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Approach, SIA635, smoke in cabin, request maintain present level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，新航635，客舱冒烟，请求保持当前高度。

cards.audioText: [Smoke is removed, you have turned off the air condition system, you want radar vectors to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【烟清除了，你关闭了空调系统，需要雷达引导至武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, SIA635, cancel PANPAN, request radar vector to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，新航635，取消PANPAN，请求雷达引导至武汉机场。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Shanghai Control, radar contact. Proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，上海区调，雷达已识别。直飞VMB。
cards.referenceText: Direct to VMB, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞VMB，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [There is strong sound from cabin. Your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly. Slow depressurization is suspected. Request immediate descent from 10700m to 3000m. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【座舱内有巨大声响。你的仪表显示座舱压力正在慢慢升高。疑似缓慢释压。请求立即从10700米下降至3000米。紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL921. There is slow depressurization in cabin, request descent from 10700m to 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，上海区调，美联航921，客舱缓慢释压，请求离开10700米下降到3000米。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger PANPAN. Turn right heading 150. Initially descend and maintain 8900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到PANPAN。右转航向150。起始下降保持8900米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900m, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向150。下降保持8900米，美联航921。

cards.audioText: ACA587, climb and maintain 10700m within 2min.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，上升保持10700米，2分钟到。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 10700m within 2min, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持10700米，2分钟到，加航587。

cards.audioText: [When you are at 10700m, left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在10700米时，左侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求右转航行，并下降6300米。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA587, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，广州区调，加航587，左侧发动机失效，请求右转，下降6300米。

cards.audioText: ACA587, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，收到PANPAN，右转航向200，下降保持6300米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向200，下降保持6300米，加航587。

cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, negative due traffic, maintain 6000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，高度没位置，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 6000m, AFR151.

cards.audioText: [Suddenly your left engine failed at 6000m, make an urgency call ATC, and request descent and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在6000米处左侧发动机突然失效，紧急呼叫ATC，请求下降并返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR151, maintaining 6000m, left engine failure, request descent and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，法航151，保持6000米，左侧发动机失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04.[You successfully restart the left engine, decide to return to Wuhan. Inform ATC and cancel urgency.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导跑道04。【你成功地重启了左侧发动机，决定返回武汉，通知ATC取消紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR151, cancel PANPAN, we have successfully restarted the left engine, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航151，取消PANPAN，我们成功地重启了左侧发动机，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，上升保持5100米，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持5100米，没有速度限制，法航123。

cards.audioText: [During the climb, your port engine separated, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，左侧发动机分离，告诉管制员这一情况，以及你想返回着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, AFR123, our left engine falls, request to return to the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, 武汉区调，法航123，飞机左侧发动机脱落，请求返回机场。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, roger Mayday, descend and maintain 1800m on QNH1012, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，收到Mayday，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1800m, QNH1012, turn right heading 360. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360，法航123。

cards.audioText:
B: [Later.]
B: [You are now in Wuhan Control area. The purser reports that a 73-year-old woman in 35H suffers from stroke and is having a terrible headache. Report this situation to Wuhan Control and ask for landing priority. This is an emergency call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
【一会后。】
【你现在在武汉区调。乘务长报告说，35H座位上一名73岁的妇女中风，头痛得厉害。将此情况报告武汉区调，请求优先降落。这是紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Wuhan Control, CSN3001, a 73-year-old woman in 35H suffers from stroke, and is having a terrible headache, request landing priority.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，武汉区调，南方3001，35H座位上一名73岁的妇女中风，头痛得厉害，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger, report joining.
[Later...]
[A flight attendant reports that a pregnant woman is about to deliver a baby, and she is in severe pain. Inform Beijing Control the situation. This is an emergency call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C:美联航887，北京区调，收到，加入后报。
【后来...】
【一名乘务员报告说一名怀孕乘客要生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。告知北京区调，这是一个紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Beijing Control, UAL887, a pregnant woman is on board is about to deliver a baby, she is in severe pain.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，北京区调，美联航887，一名怀孕乘客将要在飞机上生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。

cards.audioText: [You are now 8900m maintaining, about 10 miles from P344, you had electrical arcing on the windshield and your windshield seemed to be cracked on the outside. You want to divert to Hefei airport immediately. Report this situation to Shanghai control, this is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你正保持在8900米，距离P344大概10海里，你的风挡玻璃上有电弧，风挡玻璃似乎从外面裂开了。你要立即备降合肥机场。将此情况报告上海区调，这是紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Shanghai control, BAW3532, 8900m maintaining, 10 miles from P344, our outer windshield seemed to be cracked due electrical arcing, request divert to Hefei.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，上海区调，英航3235，在8900米保持，P344 10海里，由于电弧，外侧风挡玻璃似乎破裂，请求改航合肥。

cards.audioText: N: [You are established contact, initiated descend for runway 36R. During descending, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage. advice Wuhan Control this situation. this is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立联系，初始下降到跑道36右，在下降过程中，你的空速和高度读数异常，大概是由于积冰堵塞。告知武汉区调，这是一个紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR896, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal due to the ice blockage during descend.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，法航896，在下降过程中，由于积冰堵塞，空速和高度读数异常。

cards.audioText: [You have departed from runway 18L, shortly after liftoff, you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request maintain runway heading.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已在跑道18左起飞，起飞后不久，飞机遭到了鸟击，右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA123, right engine failure due bird strike, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，新航123，由于鸟击，右侧发动机失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: During climb, your port engine failed, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在爬升过程中，你的左发失效了，告诉管制员这一情形，你想返场着陆，这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR113, port engine failure, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, 武汉区调，法航113，左发失效，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you fly into a flock of birds, the left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你飞入鸟群，你左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, BAW871, we encountered bird strike and our left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，英航871，我们我们遭遇鸟击，左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: You found one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现你的一个液压系统失效了，做紧急呼叫，并将此情况告诉管制员，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CSN6682, we have one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，南方6682，我们的一个液压系统失效了，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: When you are at 10,700m, your left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你在10700米时，你的左发失效了，做紧急呼叫，请求右转下降至6300米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA517, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，广州区调，加航517，左发失效，请求右转下降到6300米。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you encountered bird strike and one of your engines failed, make an urgency call and ask to return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你遭遇了鸟击，你的一个发动机失效，做紧急通话，并请求返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CES2151, engine failure due to bird strike, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN,PANPAN,PANPAN，武汉离场，东方2151，由于鸟击，发动机故障，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: [A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack. Inform the controller about that, and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: [一名乘务员告诉你，一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病。告知管制员情况，告诉他你想返回武汉，这是一个紧急呼叫]
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Wuhan Control, ACA909, we have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request direct back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan，武汉区调，加航909，我们有一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: [Before ATC replies you suddenly hit another balloon you did not see. The aircraft becomes difficult to control and you want to return to land at Chengdu. Tell ATC this. This is an Urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在管制员回复之前，你撞上了一个你没有注意到的气球，飞机变得很难控制，你想返场降落成都，告知管制员此事，这是一个紧急呼叫。]
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Chengdu Departure, CSN582, we just hit a balloon, request return to Chengdu for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，成都离场，南方582，我们撞上了一个气球，请求成都降落。

cards.audioText: [The bleed air no longer supplies, high cabin altitude warning is triggered. Make an urgency call and tell the controller you want to make an emergency descent to 3000m and request radar vector.]
cards.audioTextZh: [引气停止供应，高客舱高度警告触发，宣布紧急情况，并告诉管制员你想紧急下降到3000米，并请求雷达引导]
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Wuhan Control, CES565, we will make an emergency descent to 3000m and request radar vectors due high cabin altitude warning.
cards.referenceTextZh: Pan Pan Pan，武汉区调，东方565，我们将紧急下降到3000米，由于高客舱高度告警，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: B: [You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has banking tendency. Declare Urgency to ATC and request priority landing and emergency services.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你听到一声巨响，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。立即向空管通报紧急情况，请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。】
cards.referenceText: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, Wuhan Control, CES5325, the left wing was hit by some foreign objects. And the plane has a banking tendency. Request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: PAN PAN，PAN PAN，PAN PAN，武汉区调，东方5325，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的驾驶舱出现烟雾，向莱茵雷达管制区做遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Rhein Radar, SIA308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，莱茵雷达，新航308，驾驶舱烟雾，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。

cards.audioText: N: [During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make a distress call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在巡航时，机长突然遇到心脏病，与武汉区调进行遇险通话，请求立刻返航进行优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Control, ACA521, captain heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，武汉区调，加航521，机长心脏病发作，请求立即返航。优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, radar identified.
B: [Your captain is suddenly incapacitated with a suspected food poisoning, you have called the purser from the intercom and asked the flight attendants to get him out of the cockpit and give him first aid in time. Inform Guangzhou Control the situation and request return to land as soon as possible. This is a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，武汉区调，雷达识别了。
【机长疑似食物中毒突然失能，你已经通过内话联系了乘务长，让乘务员把他抬出驾驶舱，并及时进行急救。告知广州区调此情况并请求尽快着陆。这是一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, our captain is suddenly incapacitated with a suspected food poisoning, we have given him first aid, request land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，广州区调，国航三两幺，机长疑似食物中毒突然失能，我们已经向他进行急救，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: B: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descend for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【突然，乘务员报告后客舱有有毒气体。你决定加速下降进行除烟程序。向郑州区调做遇险呼叫，请求在3000米平飞。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. Request expedite descend for smoke removal and level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航331，后客舱有有毒气体，请求加速下降进行除烟程序，并在3000米改平。

cards.audioText: B: [You are now 15 miles southwest of LKO. Suddenly, you encountered heavy hail. The windshield was smashed and multiple cracks obscured your view. The airspeed indications in the cockpit have also become unreliable. You want to divert to Wuhan Airport. Make a distress call to Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在LKO西南15海里，突然，你遇到了强冰雹，你的风挡破裂了，裂纹阻挡了你的视野，驾驶舱里的空速指示也变得不可靠。你想改航至武汉机场，向广州区调做一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, 15 miles southwest of LKO, we encountered heavy hail. The windshield was smashed and multiple cracks obscured our view, The airspeed indications in the cockpit have also become unreliable. Request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，广州区调，国航321，LKO西南15海里，我们遇到了冰雹，我们的风挡破裂了，裂纹阻挡了我们的视野，驾驶舱里的空速指示也变得不可靠。请求改航至武汉机场。

cards.audioText: [You have departed from RWY 36L, shortly after liftoff, your starboard engine was on fire, and the EGT is very high, so you have to shut down this engine, make a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经从跑道36左起飞，起飞不久后，你右侧发动机起火，排气温度非常高，因此你关闭了该发动机，做遇险通话。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. Wuhan Tower, SIA323, right engine on fire, EGT is too high, we are shutting down the engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 武汉塔台，新航323，右侧发动机起火，排气温度过高，我们关闭了该发动机。

cards.audioText: During the descent, you encountered a strong hail and experienced heavy turbulence. The outer windshield of your aircraft cracked due to hail strike, tell your situation to Beijing Approach, and request emergency landing, this is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，你遇到了冰雹和颠簸。飞机外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，将情况告知北京区调，请求紧急着陆，这是一个遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, CSN3109, our outer windshield cracked due to hail strike, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 北京进近，南方3109，我们外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: [Your callsign is CES243, an A320 is on T22 A arrival for runway 18L. You have been told to contact Wuhan Approach. You are 5 miles south of T VOR. You have a fire warning in the cockpit. You notice that the left engine is on fire.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方243，一架A320以T22-A进场，跑道18左。你被告知联系武汉进近。你在TVOR以南5海里。你的驾驶舱内部出现火警告警。你注意到你的左侧发动机失火了。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES243, 5 miles south of T VOR, left engine on fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，武汉进近，东方243，T VOR以南5海里，左发动机失火。

cards.audioText: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descent for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [突然，你的乘务员报告客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，你决定加速下降，进行除烟，向郑州区调宣布遇险，并请求在3000米改平]
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, toxic fume in the rear cabin, we are expediting descent for smoke removal, request level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航554，客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，我们加速下降，进行除烟，请求在3000米改平。

cards.audioText: N: Suddenly, your No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, If the weather is clear at Beijing, request radar vectors to Beijing airport for priority landing. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 突然，由于沙尘暴，你的一、二发熄火了，如果北京的天气晴朗，申请雷达引导到北京机场优先降落。这是遇险通话。
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Beijing Approach, QFA432, No.1 and 2 engines failed due to dust storm. If the weather is clear at Beijing, request radar vectors to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，北京进近，澳航432，由于因沙尘暴，一、二发失效。如果北京天气晴朗，申请雷达引导到北京优先降落。
